Author: Surlako
Name: DelvUI Input Guard
Punchline: Stops DelvUI from reacting through overlapping plugin windows.
Description: Publishes interactive plugin-window rectangles to DelvUI's native third-party clipping system so DelvUI unit frames ignore hover, targeting, clicks, context menus, and drag input underneath Penumbra, QoLBar, and other ImGui windows. Use /dig for settings.
